<script>
tl.fromTo("#cam", { scale: 1 }, { scale: 1.07, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#pool", { opacity: .4, scale: .85 }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1.05, duration: 1.2, ease: "power2.out" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#stars", { y: 20, opacity: 0 }, { y: -40, opacity: 1, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#fgRing", { rotation: 0, svgOrigin: "-120 1900" }, { rotation: 10, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);
tl.fromTo("#fgRing2", { rotation: 0, svgOrigin: "1250 -150" }, { rotation: -14, duration: DURATION, ease: "none" }, 0);

// The camera draws itself on, line by line, then starts recording.
tl.to("#camera .draw", { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: .7, stagger: .07, ease: "power3.out" }, .05);
tl.fromTo("#rec", { scale: 0, svgOrigin: "742 514" }, { scale: 1, duration: .35, ease: "back.out(2.2)" }, at("Record", .2) + .45);
tl.fromTo("#recHalo", { scale: .5, opacity: 1, svgOrigin: "742 514" }, { scale: 1.6, opacity: 0, duration: .6, ease: "power2.out" }, at("Record", .2) + .55);

// "upload it": the camera shrinks into the hub and the ring fills around it.
const up = at("upload", 1.3);
tl.to("#camera", { scale: .38, x: -8, svgOrigin: "540 600", duration: .6, ease: "power3.inOut" }, up - .1);
tl.fromTo("#track", { scale: .6, opacity: 0, svgOrigin: "540 600" }, { scale: 1, opacity: 1, duration: .5, ease: "expo.out" }, up + .15);
tl.to("#ring", { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: .9, ease: "power2.inOut" }, up + .3);
tl.fromTo("#halo", { opacity: 0, rotation: 0, svgOrigin: "540 600" }, { opacity: .6, rotation: 90, duration: 2.4, ease: "none" }, up + .3);

// "everywhere": six lines shoot out and every screen lights up in turn.
const out = at("everywhere", 2.6);
tl.fromTo(".phone", { opacity: 0, scale: .7, svgOrigin: "540 600" }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: .6, stagger: .04, ease: "expo.out" }, out - .35);
for (let i = 0; i < 6; i++) {
  const t = out + i * .08;
  tl.to("#l" + i, { strokeDashoffset: 0, duration: .28, ease: "power2.in" }, t);
  tl.to("#ps" + i, { stroke: "#FFFFFF", duration: .15, ease: "none" }, t + .26);
  tl.to("#pg" + i, { opacity: .32, duration: .3, ease: "power2.out" }, t + .26);
  tl.fromTo("#pc" + i, { opacity: 0, scale: .4, transformOrigin: "50% 50%" }, { opacity: 1, scale: 1, duration: .35, ease: "back.out(2)" }, t + .3);
}
tl.to("#hub", { scale: 1.08, svgOrigin: "540 600", duration: .18, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "power2.out" }, out + .75);
</script>
